newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Sept overseas ship orders up 59% year/year.
newsitem.headline: Japan Sept overseas ship orders up 59% year/year.

text.p: Ship export contracts concluded by Japanese shipbuilders in September totalled 27 vessels, or 790,000 gross registered tonnes (grt), up 58.8 percent from a year earlier, an industry body said on Thursday.
Orders for September comprised seven freighters, 17 bulk carriers, one oil tanker and two other types of vessels, the Japan Ship Exporters' Association said in a statement.
From April to September, Japan received ship orders for 116 vessels, or 3.82 million grt, the association said.
